correctness.rationale: Exact line/conic pair counts and cited near-free numerical inputs give only three profiles. For <=2 nodes, per-line parity rules out any line-line node. The one-node profile forces an odd count of transverse line hits on either conic, impossible. The two-node profile forces precisely two line-triples, four corner LLQ triples, monochromatic four-cycle assignment, and then either three concurrent tangents to a smooth conic or a smooth conic tangent to the shared line through four fixed corners, both impossible. All integer and four-corner checks replayed from verify_cases.py; no finite enumeration is promoted to an infinite proof.
